title: Australian officer says Buchanan also knocked out Australian computers
place_text: Bureau of Indian Affairs cafeteria; Australia

tellings.quote: You know, you're the one that knocked out our computers over in Australia."

plain: An Australian officer once told Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, that he was the one who had knocked out their computers in Australia as well. Buchanan tells it himself, recalling the encounter in a cafeteria at the Bureau of Indian Affairs, a US government agency, where the man said: "you're the one that knocked out our computers over in Australia." It is told to suggest Buchanan's effect on machines had reached well beyond the United States.
